==Biography==
===Season 3===
Vizicsacsi's first stint on a team was with [[Animate eSports]], where he played in a number of minor tournaments. He also had the chance to compete at [[Gfinity London 2013]]. After 4 months on the team, the roster was released to make way for new players, leaving Vizicsacsi teamless.

Soon after, he joined [[Eternity Gaming]], but the team's roster disbanded just a few weeks later.

===2014 Season===
At the start of the season, Vizicsacsi joined challenger team [[Unicorns of Love]].

The team won several [[Go4LoL]] tournaments in early 2014 on the EU West server. As the year progressed, they started to play in more prominent challenger events and do well, taking third place in the [[2014_Black_Monster_Cup_Europe_Summer|Summer Black Monster Cup]]. They participated in the first [[2014_EU_Challenger_Series/Spring_Series|Spring Series #1]] play-in but were eliminated by [[EYES ON U]] in the second round.

Soon after, the team qualified for the [[2014_EU_Challenger_Series/Summer_Series|Summer Series #1]] of the EUCS, but lost to [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]] 2-0 in the quarterfinals.

Another quarterfinal finish in [[2014_EU_Challenger_Series/Summer_Series/Series_2|Summer Series #2]] meant that Vizicsacsi and the team had qualified for the [[2014_EU_Challenger_Series/Summer_Series/Playoffs|Summer Playoffs]]. 

The playoffs went particularly well for the team, despite the Unicorns of Love losing to [[H2k-Gaming]] in the semifinal. The team went on to beat [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]] in the third-place match, securing themselves a spot at the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/Europe/2015_Season/Spring_Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]].

With the Promotion Tournament came a chance for Vizicsacsi and the Unicorns of Love to qualify for the 2015 LCS [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/Europe/2015_Season/Spring_Round_Robin|Spring Split]]. The Promotion Tournament was a huge success, with the team beating [[Millenium]] 3-2 in their promotion matchup. This meant that Vizicsacsi would be playing in the LCS the following season. 

===2015 Season===
Unicorns of Love were the European team fan-voted to [[IEM_Season_IX_-_San_Jose|IEM San Jose]].<ref>[http://en.intelextrememasters.com/news/cloud9-and-unicorns-of-love-confirmed-get-your-tickets-now/ Cloud9 and Unicorns of Love confirmed, get your tickets now!] ''en.intelextrememasters.com''</ref> With a roster of [[Vizicsacsi]], [[Kikis]], [[PowerOfEvil]], [[Vardags]], and [[Hylissang]] at the tournament, they surprised audiences by making it to the semifinals after defeating [[Lyon Gaming (2013 Latin American Team)|Lyon Gaming]] 2-0 and then [[Team SoloMid]] 2-0. They placed second at the tournament, losing to [[Cloud9]] in the finals. Vizicsacsi was nominated for the MVP award along with [[Rekkles]], [[PowerOfEvil]], [[Kikis]], and [[Sneaky]] but lost the vote to Sneaky.

The [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/Europe/2015_Season/Spring_Round_Robin|EU LCS Spring Season]] was a huge success for Vizicsacsi and [[Unicorns Of Love]], finishing the regular season in 5th place, partly thanks to Vizicsacsi's impressive performances on {{ci|Maokai}} and {{ci|Gnar}}. This meant that team would participate in the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Spring Playoffs|Spring Playoffs]], where they would face and beat [[Gambit Gaming]] in the quarterfinals. Vizicsacsi and the team managed to make LCS history when they became the first team to knock out a 1st place regular season finisher in the playoff semifinals, taking down [[SK Gaming]] convincingly. They went on to lose the playoff final to [[Fnatic]] in a close-fought series, finishing 2nd in their first LCS split, and picking up 70 [[2015 Season/Championship Points|Championship Points]] in the process.

The [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/Europe/2015_Season/Spring_Round_Robin|Summer Season]] was equally as successful for [[Unicorns Of Love]], finishing the regular season in 4th place, this time thanks Vizicsacsi's performances on a number of champions. This ensured the team's participation in the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Summer Playoffs|Summer Playoffs]], where they overcame [[Team ROCCAT]] in the quarterfinals but were taken out themselves in the semifinals by a dominant [[Fnatic]]. 40 [[2015 Season/Championship Points|Championship Points]] gained here secured [[Unicorns Of Love]] a spot in the  [[2015 Season Europe Regional Finals]]. Despite their high seeding, they were beaten by [[Origen]] in the final of the gauntlet.

===2016 Season===
After Fnatic withdrew from [[IEM Season X - San Jose|IEM San Jose]] due to medical problems, Unicorns of Love took their spot, fielding [[Hylissang]] and Vizicsacsi from their 2015 roster along with new members [[Gilius]], [[Fox (Hampus Myhre)|Fox]], and [[Steeelback]]. Vizicsacsi and the team were eliminated in the quarterfinals of the tournament by [[Counter Logic Gaming]]. UOL finished in fifth place in the [[League Championship Series/Europe/2016 Season/Spring Season|LCS]], after being forced to replace [[Diamondprox]] in the jungle due to visa issues. They were eliminated in the [[League Championship Series/Europe/2016 Season/Spring Playoffs|quarterfinals]] by Origen.

===2019 Season===
He announced his retirement on November 15, three days before his contract with [[Splyce]] ran out.<ref>[https://www.twitlonger.com/show/n_1sr2itp Vizicsacsi's TwitLonger] ''twitlonger.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Vizicsacsi''' means "water donkey" in Hungarian.
* Was a professional ''[[wikipedia:en:Age_of_Mythology|Age of Mythology]]'' player, as ''Magyar.''
* Used to play chess competitively.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FE4yGZe_pM0 Player Spotlight: Vizicsacsi]youtube.com</ref>
* Studied Psychology for 2 and a half years before dropping it to go to LCS.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OOTXBBO4Mx0 The Shotcaller Interview]youtube.com</ref>
* Famous for his {{ci|Poppy}} pick in the 2015 EU LCS Spring promotion tournament against [[Millenium]].
* Used to play off-meta top lane picks on the LCS Stage like {{ci|Nocturne}} with [[Smite]], Tank {{ci|Fizz}}, {{ci|Yorick}} and {{ci|Poppy}} (before rework).
* Got married in 2022. <ref>[https://twitter.com/Vizicsacsi/status/1530832591519113217 Visicsacsi Tweet]Twitter.com </ref>
